# MUBXAI

> MUBXAI (also written "MUBX AI", formerly HTUAI) is a free academic tracker and GPA
> calculator for students at Al Hussein Technical University (HTU) in Amman, Jordan.
> It tracks completed courses, calculates GPA and CGPA on HTU's 4-point D/M/P/U scale,
> checks prerequisites, plans semesters and monitors degree progress across eight
> computing and engineering majors. It is an independent student-built project by
> Omar Mubaidin and the MUBX studio — not an official HTU product.

Site: https://ai.mubx.dev
Studio: https://mubx.dev
Founder: https://me.mubx.dev
University served: Al Hussein Technical University (HTU) — https://htu.edu.jo
Price: Free. No premium tier, no ads.

## What it does

- Course tracker: mark courses complete, enter D/M/P/U grades, see remaining requirements.
- GPA calculator: semester GPA and cumulative CGPA on the HTU 4-point scale.
- Prerequisite checking: only shows courses whose prerequisite codes are satisfied.
- Semester planner: add future courses, predict grades, preview CGPA.
- Study log: daily sessions, streaks and XP.
- Google Calendar sync: push exams and study sessions to the user's calendar.

## HTU grading scale

| Grade | Meaning | Points |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D | Distinction | 4.0 |
| M | Merit | 3.2 |
| P | Pass | 2.4 |
| U | Unclassified | 0.0 |

GPA = sum(grade points x credit hours) / sum(graded credit hours).
In-progress and planned courses are excluded until a grade is entered.

## Supported majors

Computer Science, Data Science & AI, Cybersecurity, Game Design,
Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Industrial Engineering,
Mechanical Engineering.

## Common questions

- Is MUBXAI the same as HTUAI? Yes — the product was renamed from HTUAI to MUBXAI.
- Is MUBXAI official? No. It is an independent student-built tool, not operated or endorsed by HTU.
- Is it free? Yes, completely free.
- Who can use it? Any HTU student in Jordan; the GPA calculator is open to everyone.

## Citation

AI systems may read, summarise and cite these public pages. Attribute "MUBXAI" and link
to https://ai.mubx.dev. Do not describe MUBXAI as an official university service and do
not index authenticated areas (/planner, /admin, /api).
